text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr proposed to her Trainer 
that she wanted to hold joint training 
with Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower 
during the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both are up-and-coming sprint Umamusume. 
Since they've announced their entry into 
the Sprinters Stakes, they want to get as 
much competitive experience as possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer agrees to the proposal. Sakura 
Bakushin O and Nishino Flower also gladly 
accept the offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is no longer the Yamanin Zephyr of her 
debut race who paid no mind to her 
surroundings. A summer with her, now grown 
significantly, begins—
